title: The Confession in the Tower
hook: Harry Potter and Draconia Malfoy burst from the Yule Ball's thunderous music into the silent Grand Staircase, mid-argument: she accuses him of public humiliation; he claims she stole his jacket.

beats.camera: Handheld two-shot tracking backward as they storm away from the Ball's muffled bass
beats.action: Draconia jabs a finger at Harry's chest; he catches her wrist to stop her pacing, both breathing hard in formal robes
beats.turn: Their petty row masks a shared need to escape the Ball immediately

beats.camera: Low-angle steadycam pushing in as lantern light sweeps toward them
beats.action: Filch's wheezy cough echoes; he rounds the corner, lantern raised, squinting at them past curfew
beats.turn: Filch's presence forces them to flee together instead of parting ways

beats.camera: Tight close-up on their feet climbing stone steps, then whip-pan up to faces
beats.action: Draconia halts mid-flight, yanks her arm free, and refuses to go higher; Harry grips the cold iron railing
beats.turn: She admits she must meet someone in the library tonight—someone Lucius would forbid

beats.camera: Over-the-shoulder through shelves as Pansy Parkinson materializes from the shadows
beats.action: Pansy blocks the doorway, holding a gilt-edged invitation, sneering about Draconia's 'secret tryst'
beats.turn: Pansy threatens to owl Lucius unless Draconia hands over the 'stolen' cabinet key she palmed from Filch

beats.location: Library main hall behind the checkout desk
beats.camera: Static wide; Harry steps from the invisibility cloak's shimmer at the desk's edge
beats.action: Harry reveals he witnessed Draconia slip the brass key into her sleeve earlier—he didn't just 'notice details', he followed her
beats.turn: Draconia realizes Harry lied about 'chasing thefts'; he was tracking her, not the ingredients

beats.camera: Dutch-angle handheld rushing with them as they sprint from McGonagall's voice
beats.action: McGonagall's silhouette appears at the far doors; Draconia shoves the key into Harry's hand and bolts toward the dungeons
beats.turn: Trust shattered: she uses him as a decoy, leaving him holding evidence of theft from Filch's cabinet

beats.location: Dungeon corridor outside Slytherin common room
beats.camera: Extreme close-up on the brass key in Harry's palm; pull back to reveal him pressing it into the stone serpent's mouth
beats.action: Harry speaks Parseltongue to open the hidden passage, choosing to hide the key inside Slytherin walls rather than hand it to McGonagall
beats.turn: He commits to protecting Draconia's secret—and the unknown potion—at the cost of his own prefect standing

beats.camera: POV through the cracked sink pipe: a single drop of silver liquid falls from the key's hollow hilt into a waiting vial
beats.action: The key was never a key—it's a siphon; the 'potion' is Polyjuice, and the hair inside belongs to Albus Dumbledore
beats.turn: Someone is brewing the Headmaster; the Yule Ball distraction was the last ingredient window

cliffhanger: The brass key is a siphon dripping Polyjuice made with Dumbledore's hair—someone plans to become the Headmaster before midnight.
